Packages that use DataKeyProvider
Package
Description
org.jwcarman.codec.crypto
Envelope encryption as a Codec<byte[]> transform: AES-256-GCM over a per-message data key that is itself wrapped by a key-encryption key reached through the DataKeyProvider SPI (in-process JCE or a remote KMS).
